svg.title: UNO - nested Swing classes

g.text: JPanel/JButton API boxes repeat across sections for readability. Icon and Scrollable are interfaces.
Section headings indicate lexical nesting. Static nested classes do not retain an implicit outer instance.
GamePanel owns its badges, colour icon and pile views; it creates CardButton components for the displayed hand.
UiTheme.surface creates RoundedPanel; UiTheme.button creates GameButton. Utility nesting does not imply ownership.
11 named nested UI types are shown. GameConfig.PlayerConfig is in the core diagram. Anonymous adapters are omitted.
Solid hollow triangle: extends Dashed hollow triangle: implements Filled diamond: owned field
